**7B.10 Research Note: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in 2024**

**Bottom line:** mixed-to-negative. Lula did model some public-facing ethical standards in 2024, especially around accountability for the January 8 coup plot and formal transparency/rules in parts of government. But the year also contains credible evidence of unwillingness to correct inflammatory claims, pressure on independent institutions, and tolerance of politically connected allies. I did not find strong 2024 evidence on pardons/clemency specifically.

### Accepted claims

- **Brazil to mark anniversary of January 8 attack on democracy** — [Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163), 2024-01-08.  
  Claim: Lula said those who financed, planned, and executed the coup attempt should be punished. This supports a public standard of accountability rather than impunity.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York** — [Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york), 2024-09-24.  
  Claim: Lula condemned racist, xenophobic, misogynistic, and anti-minority narratives and argued democracy depends on pluralism, rights, and transparent political processes. This is pro-trust rhetoric and models restraint rather than cynicism.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Where can I access speeches and transcripts?** — [Secretaria de Comunicação Social](https://www.gov.br/secom/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/onde-posso-acessar-discurso-e), 2024-03-21.  
  Claim: the government directs the public to official transcripts, audio, and video archives of Lula’s speeches. That supports a transparency-oriented communications posture.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Integrity programs for federal contracts** — [Controladoria-Geral da União / Presidência da República](https://www.gov.br/cgu/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/12/dia-internacional-de-combate-a-corrupcao-presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-fortalece-integridade-em-contratos-publicos), 2024-12-09.  
  Claim: Lula signed a decree requiring large contractors to implement integrity programs, with CGU monitoring and integrity used in procurement. This is direct anti-self-dealing, anti-corruption governance.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Lula to nominate Galípolo as central bank chief** — [Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764), 2024-08-28.  
  Claim: Lula chose a serving central-bank monetary policy director with finance-ministry experience, which reads as a technocratic appointment rather than a pure loyalist pick.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Brazil will not retract Lula’s Gaza comments** — [Reuters via ThePrint](https://theprint.in/world/brazil-will-not-retract-lulas-gaza-comments-in-diplomatic-row-with-israel-sources/1972033/), 2024-02-20.  
  Claim: after backlash over the Hitler/Gaza comparison, Brazil chose not to retract it. This is negative evidence on correction and accountability: the administration stood by a highly charged claim rather than correcting course.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Lula repeats genocide accusation after diplomatic row** — [Reuters via UOL](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm), 2024-02-23.  
  Claim: Lula doubled down on the genocide accusation instead of walking it back. This is the clearest 2024 counterexample to a corrective, truth-respecting public standard.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Government’s platform bill and fine threat** — [Reuters Institute](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/brazil), 2024-06-17.  
  Claim: the justice minister threatened an hourly fine when Google opposed the fake-news bill. This is a real pressure signal on the information environment and weakens the clean-trust reading, even if framed as anti-disinformation.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **YouTube removed false Lula health videos after AGU notice** — [Advocacia-Geral da União](https://www.gov.br/agu/pt-br/comunicacao/noticias/youtube-retira-do-ar-desinformacao-sobre-estado-de-saude-do-presidente-da-republica/), 2024-12-16.  
  Claim: the state used official legal pressure to remove videos spreading false claims about Lula’s health. This may be defensible anti-disinformation, but it is still active state management of information flow and a caution sign for the trust/cynicism lens.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Communications minister indicted and not immediately removed** — [Reuters via UOL](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm), 2024-06-12, and [Reuters via UOL](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/13/lula-diz-que-tomara-decisao-sobre-juscelino-filho-e-que-indiciamento-nao-significa-que-ministro-cometeu-erro.amp.htm), 2024-06-13.  
  Claim: Juscelino Filho was indicted in a Codevasf corruption probe tied to public works and Lula did not immediately remove him. This is the clearest patronage/capture caveat and a serious hit to the “ethical standards” side of the lens.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

- **Petrobras dividend interference and investigation request** — [Reuters via UOL](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/20/fazenda-insiste-com-lula-por-aval-a-dividendo-extra-da-petrobras.amp.htm), 2024-03-20, and [Reuters via UOL](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm), 2024-03-18.  
  Claim: Reuters reported pressure on Lula to block extraordinary Petrobras dividends, and the TCU prosecutor sought an investigation into possible government interference. This is strong evidence of politicized steering of a strategic state-linked firm.  
  Question IDs: `7B.10`

### Search gap

- I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence showing Lula using pardons/clemency in a clientelist or self-dealing way.
- I also did **not** find direct proof of personal financial self-dealing by Lula himself in 2024. The strongest negatives were instead about rhetorical overreach, institutional pressure, and tolerance of connected allies.
